title: Product collection
description: A collection of the catalogue on any page or region: the same cards as in a listing, as a grid or a carousel. Nothing is printed while it is off, empty or in the bin.

schema.label: Heading
schema.help: Empty — the title of the collection; a dash (-) — no heading.

schema.label: How many
schema.help: Empty — as in the collection. It can only lower the collection’s own limit.
